A saved reel: "someone open sourced a computer that works when the internet goes down." It's real. 🛰️

Project N.O.M.A.D. is free and open source:
• Offline Wikipedia
• A local AI assistant
• Offline maps
• Khan Academy courses

Runs on an old PC or mini PC. Storage is the main cost.
